edits.why: Dial function M/B (validator record 0x604ccd74, list 0x604bb43c): first entry {FNo., Shutter} (3,4) becomes {Shutter, Exposure comp} (4,2), byte for byte the second entry of the shutter-priority record 0x604bb3bc. The second entry stays the stock {Shutter, FNo.} (4,3).
Dial M/B page, label list of the first dial (0x611d6d28), GUI value 4 (first choice): label id 659 (FNo.) -> 660 (Shutter).
Dial M/B page, label list of the second dial (0x611d6d40), GUI value 4 (first choice): label id 660 (Shutter) -> 658 (@A008@, exposure comp icon, the label the A/S pages use for that function).

Rule engine (base 0x6045efac, sid 2 = exposure compensation): the group 0 for mode M (sid 24 == 6) also requires sid 15210 == 0 (conditions at 0x6044afd0); the engine then returns 'disabled' (256) and the dial rule 69 refuses. The compared value becomes 2, which a 0/1 setting never has, so group 0 never applies in M; group 41 (sid 15210 == 1) is unchanged. Exposure comp is then accepted in M like in P/A/S (engine result 0 in the emulator).
